Officer's narrative
On arrival at the intersection in Sugar Land, Texas, I found a rear-end collision between a sedan operated by Driver 1
and an SUV operated by Driver 2. Passenger was seated in the front passenger seat of Driver 1's vehicle. Driver 2
stated that the sedan stopped abruptly at the signal and that the SUV struck it from behind. Two independent
witnesses and photographs taken at the scene support that account. Driver 1 reported pain in the right shoulder and
was transported by EMS for evaluation. The nature of the injury and the force of the impact appear consistent with
each other. Driver 1 is listed as the named insured on the policy covering the sedan. Records retrieved during
follow-up show that the sedan had sustained smiilar major front-end damage in an earlier incident that was never
reported to police or the insurer. It is not clear from the physical evidence whether all of the current damage resulted
from this collision. A supplemental inspection has been requested to determine the extent of the prior damage.
</page>

it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
